Game Overview

At its heart, So Different Dragons is a clicker game about quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Playing So Different Dragons comes down to a simple loop. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is So Different Dragons?

So Different Dragons is a free clicker game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is So Different Dragons free to play?

Yes, So Different Dragons is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
